Zero Motorcycles | Engineering Manager (Firmware), Software Engineer (Cloud) | Scotts Valley, CA (Hybrid) | https://zeromotorcycles.com/

We build electric motorcycles. Our bikes work well on their own today. We’re building a connected system across the bike, cloud, and field tools so we can see how they behave in the real world, understand what changes actually do, and use that to decide what’s worth building.

That means owning behavior end-to-end, from firmware on the bike to the systems that observe and update it, and making sure it is reliable and secure in the real world.

We’re hiring for:

I. Firmware Engineering Manager (Products & Systems) https://zeromotorcycles.recruitee.com/o/firmware-engineering...

II. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform https://zeromotorcycles.recruitee.com/o/software-engineer-ii...

If this sounds interesting, apply or reach out.
